subject: general
question:
In the figure, PQ = QR and PS = SR . What is the value (in degrees) of angle RSQ ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf1fbe6f8882521d5115de888de1dffca6b9b0e7212f5254e60c45c21c8e63ec.png]
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ In kite PQRS, diagonal QS bisects the interior angle ∠PQR. ∠RQS = ∠PQR ÷ 2 = 70° ÷ 2 = 35°. By symmetry in kite PQRS, ∠QRS = ∠QPS = 40°. In ▵RSQ, sum of angles = 180°. ∠RSQ = 180° − (∠RQS + ∠QRS) = 180° − (35° + 40°) = 105°. **∴ The correct answer is 105.**
